name: Tsuge (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsuge village emblem in green: a ring enclosing a stylised character with pointed strokes at the top.
history: Flag of the former village of Tsuge in Nara Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1979.

features.role: Tsuge village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character with pointed strokes at the top
